dataset: 锦溪古镇石刻题字 +《论语·雍也》对照数据集（中英双语）

records.item_en: Stone archway plaque "Wénxīng Lǎngzhào" (The Literary Star Shines Brightly)
records.location: 江苏昆山·锦溪古镇 古莲长堤「水乡佛国」石牌坊（西面）
records.location_en: West face of the "Shuǐxiāng Fóguó" (Buddha-land of the Water Town) stone archway at the head of the Gǔlián Causeway, Jǐnxī Ancient Town, Kūnshān, Jiangsu
records.script_type: 篆书；石面阴刻、填绿彩；刻于石额方框内
records.script_type_en: Seal script; intaglio carving on stone, inlaid with green pigment; carved within a framed stone panel
records.english: "The Literary Star shines brightly." (lit. "the star of letters shines its light afar")
records.meaning: 文星，即文昌星、文曲星，古人视为主掌文运科名的星宿；朗，明亮；照，照耀。四字意为“文运之星朗朗高照”，用来称颂锦溪文风昌盛、才俊辈出。此石牌坊立于古莲长堤（古莲池）东入口，东面匾额为“水乡佛国”，西面（即图中一面）为“文星朗照”，两面各配一副长联。
records.meaning_en: "Wénxīng" (the Star of Literature) is another name for Wénchāng xīng / Wénqū xīng, the stellar deity believed in old China to govern literary fortune and examination success. "Lǎng" means bright, and "zhào" means to shine. The four characters mean "the Star of Literature shines brightly," praising Jǐnxī for its flourishing culture of learning and its many outstanding scholars. This stone archway stands at the eastern entrance to the Gǔlián Causeway (by the Gǔlián Pond). Its east face reads "Shuǐxiāng Fóguó" ("Buddha-land of the Water Town"), while the west face (shown here) reads "Wénxīng Lǎngzhào," and each face is flanked by a long couplet.
records.key_glosses: 文星＝文昌星/文曲星，主文运科名；朗＝明亮；照＝照耀
records.key_glosses_en: Wénxīng = Star of Literature (Wénchāng/Wénqū), governs literary fortune; lǎng = bright; zhào = to shine
records.confidence: 高（图中篆书字形与当地文献记载完全吻合）
records.confidence_en: High (the seal-script forms in the photo match local records exactly)
records.notes: 匾额自古自右向左读，故照片中最右一字为“文”，最左一字为“照”。
records.notes_en: Traditional plaques are read right-to-left, so the rightmost character in the photo is "文" (wén) and the leftmost is "照" (zhào).

records.item_en: Gate plaque "Mǎ Ruòtè Ní Chán Fāng" (Ma Ruote's Clay-Zen Studio)
records.source_image_en: Image 2 (black-ground gold-character wooden plaque over the gate)
records.location: 江苏昆山·锦溪古镇 下塘街·锦溪王宅（昆山市文物保护单位）内「马若特泥禅坊艺术馆」
records.location_en: Inside the "Mǎ Ruòtè Ní Chán Fāng Art Museum," housed in the "Jǐnxī Wáng Zhái" (a Kunshan municipal protected heritage site) on Xiàtáng Street, Jǐnxī Ancient Town
records.original_text: 馬若特泥禪坊（右侧小字署款：壬辰年）
records.script_type: 楷书（略带行意）；黑底金字木匾，四周刻回纹边框
records.script_type_en: Regular script (slightly running-style); black-ground gold-character wooden board with a key-fret (回纹) border
records.pinyin: Mǎ Ruòtè Ní Chán Fāng（Rénchén nián）
records.english: "Ma Ruote's Clay-Zen Studio" (泥禅坊 = "clay-and-zen workshop"; 壬辰年 = the Renchen year, i.e. 2012)
records.meaning: 马若特，1974年生，河北曲阳（灵山镇辉岭村）人，曲阳泥塑非物质文化遗产代表性传承人、河北省工艺美术大师，人称“泥人马”。“泥禅坊”是他1998年在曲阳创办的泥陶（泥塑）工作室之名：泥，指泥塑、泥陶；禅，取其静穆、参悟之意。2012年9月，他租下锦溪古镇下塘街的清代老宅“锦溪王宅”，开设“马若特泥禅坊艺术馆”，展出泥塑作品两百余件。匾侧小字“壬辰年”为干支纪年，对应2012年，与开馆时间相合。
records.meaning_en: Mǎ Ruòtè (b. 1974, from Huīlǐng Village, Língshān Town, Qūyáng, Hebei) is an inheritor of the intangible-cultural-heritage Qūyáng clay sculpture and a master craftsman of arts and crafts of Hebei Province, nicknamed "Clay-Man Ma." "Ní Chán Fāng" is the name he gave the clay-and-ceramic studio he founded in Qūyáng in 1998: "ní" (clay) refers to clay sculpture / clay ceramic, and "chán" (Zen) captures a sense of quietness and contemplation. In September 2012 he rented the Qing-era old residence "Jǐnxī Wáng Zhái" on Xiàtáng Street and opened the "Mǎ Ruòtè Ní Chán Fāng Art Museum," exhibiting over 200 clay-sculpture works. The small inscription "Rénchén nián" on the right is a gānzhī (sexagenary-cycle) year, corresponding to 2012, which tallies with the museum's opening.
records.key_glosses: 马若特＝泥塑艺术家姓名；泥＝泥塑/泥陶；禅＝禅意、静思；坊＝作坊、工作室；壬辰年＝干支纪年，即2012年
records.key_glosses_en: Mǎ Ruòtè = the clay artist's name; ní = clay / clay sculpture; chán = Zen, quiet contemplation; fāng = workshop / studio; Rénchén nián = a sexagenary-cycle year, i.e. 2012
records.confidence: 高（第4字“泥”在原照片中笔画略糊，但与“泥禅坊”的文献记载一致）
records.confidence_en: High (the 4th character "泥" / ní is slightly blurred in the photo but matches the documented "Ní Chán Fāng")
records.notes: 匾下为黑色板门，右侧墙上另有禁烟（禁止吸烟）标识，属展馆门口场景。
records.notes_en: Below the plaque are black wooden doors; on the right wall there is also a "no smoking" sign, indicating a museum entrance scene.

records.item: 石牌坊右柱楹联（上联）「枯灯夜读桃李春风胜秋色」
records.item_en: Stone archway right-pillar couplet (upper line) "Kū dēng yè dú táo lǐ chūn fēng shèng qiū sè"
records.source_image_en: Image 3 (vertical inscription on a stone pillar)
records.location: 同上石牌坊（与「文星朗照」同一面，居右石柱）
records.location_en: Right pillar on the same face as "Wénxīng Lǎngzhào," same stone archway (upper line, right side)
records.original_text: 枯燈夜讀桃李春風勝秋色
records.script_type: 篆书；石面阴刻、填绿彩；竖排一行，两侧饰回纹、云头纹
records.script_type_en: Seal script; intaglio on stone, inlaid with green pigment; one vertical line, flanked by key-fret and cloud-head motifs
records.reading_order_en: Top → Bottom (right pillar read as upper line)
records.simplified: 枯灯夜读桃李春风胜秋色
records.pinyin: Kū dēng yè dú táo lǐ chūn fēng shèng qiū sè
records.english: "A guttering lamp, reading through the night — peach and plum blossoms in the spring breeze outshine autumn's tints."
records.meaning: 写锦溪人刻苦读书、文教昌明的风气。“枯灯夜读”是寒窗苦读的意象（灯油将尽而仍在夜读）；“桃李春风”既指镇上桃李夹岸、春风和煦的实景——锦溪镇志称镇名得自“一溪穿镇而过，夹岸桃李纷披，晨霞夕辉尽洒水面，满溪跃金，灿若锦带”——又暗用典故：“桃李”喻门生弟子，“春风”喻良师教诲（春风化雨）；“胜秋色”谓这般景象与人才之盛，胜过秋日的绚烂。与左柱下联“故土梦萦锦溪金波逐玉浪”相对：上联写向学之勤、教化之美，下联写爱乡之情、水乡之景。
records.meaning_en: This celebrates Jǐnxī's tradition of diligent study and flourishing education. "Kū dēng yè dú" (reading by a guttering lamp at night) is the image of hard study by a cold window. "Táo lǐ chūn fēng" (peach and plum in the spring breeze) refers both to the real scenery — the town gazetteer says Jǐnxī got its name because "a stream runs through the town, peach and plum trees spread along both banks, morning rosy clouds and evening light gild the water, the whole stream glitters like gold, bright as a brocade ribbon" — and alludes to two classic tropes: "táo lǐ" (peach and plum) as a metaphor for one's students/disciples, and "chūn fēng" (spring breeze) as a metaphor for a teacher's nurture ("spring breeze and rain"). "Shèng qiū sè" says that this scene — and the abundance of talent — surpasses the splendor of autumn. It faces the left-pillar lower line "Gù tǔ mèng yíng Jǐnxī jīn bō zhú yù làng": the upper line writes of devotion to study and the beauty of edification, the lower line of love for home and the scenery of the water town.
records.key_glosses: 枯灯＝将尽的油灯，喻苦读；夜读＝夜里读书；桃李＝桃树李树，喻学生、门生；春风＝春日的风，喻良师教诲；胜＝超过；秋色＝秋天的景色
records.key_glosses_en: kū dēng = a guttering oil lamp, i.e. hard study; yè dú = reading at night; táo lǐ = peach and plum, metaphor for students; chūn fēng = spring breeze, metaphor for a teacher's nurture; shèng = to surpass; qiū sè = autumn scenery
records.confidence: 中高（照片为篆书、个别字略糊；字句与当地文献所载楹联一致，全句11字及关键位置均吻合）
records.confidence_en: Medium-high (the photo is in seal script and a few characters are faint; the wording matches the local record, and the length — 11 characters — and key anchor characters all agree)
records.notes: 照片中首字（枯/情、清之形）与第3字（夜）、第6字（李）、第8字（风）辨识度较低，已据字数、第四字“读”、第五字“桃”、第七字“春”、第九至十一字“胜秋色”等锚点字校定。
records.notes_en: In the photo the first character (枯 vs. 情/清), the 3rd (夜), the 6th (李), and the 8th (风) are harder to read; they were verified using the character count and unambiguous anchor characters such as "讀/dú" (4th), "桃/táo" (5th), "春/chūn" (7th), and "勝秋色/shèng qiū sè" (9th–11th).

records.item: 石牌坊左柱楹联（下联）「故土梦萦锦溪金波逐玉浪」
records.item_en: Stone archway left-pillar couplet (lower line) "Gù tǔ mèng yíng Jǐnxī jīn bō zhú yù làng" (companion line)
records.source_image: 文献配对句（不在所给照片中，供对照）
records.source_image_en: Companion line from records (not in the provided photos)
records.location_en: Left pillar on the same stone archway
records.original_text: 故土夢縈錦溪金波逐玉浪
records.script_type: 篆书；石面阴刻、填绿彩；竖排
records.script_type_en: Seal script; intaglio on stone, inlaid with green pigment; vertical
records.simplified: 故土梦萦锦溪金波逐玉浪
records.pinyin: Gù tǔ mèng yíng Jǐn xī jīn bō zhú yù làng
records.english: "One's native soil lingers in dreams; in Jinxi, golden waves chase jade billows."
records.meaning: 对故乡的思念魂牵梦萦；锦溪的溪水泛起金色波光，追逐着如玉的浪花。“金波逐玉浪”既写水乡水色之美（晨霞夕辉尽洒水面，满溪跃金），亦寄托游子对家乡的深情；锦溪之名正是取“满溪跃金，灿若锦带”之意。
records.meaning_en: One's native soil lingers in dreams; in Jǐnxī, golden waves chase jade billows. "Jīn bō zhú yù làng" (golden waves chasing jade billows) describes the beauty of the water town's waters — morning rosy clouds and evening light gilding the surface, the whole stream glittering like gold — and also conveys a traveler's deep affection for home. The name Jǐnxī itself comes from "the stream glitters like gold, bright as a brocade ribbon."
records.key_glosses: 故土＝家乡；梦萦＝在梦中萦绕；金波＝金色的水波；逐＝追逐；玉浪＝如玉般的浪花
records.key_glosses_en: gù tǔ = native soil / home; mèng yíng = to haunt one's dreams; jīn bō = golden waves; zhú = to chase; yù làng = jade-like billows

records.item: 《论语·雍也》「子华使于齐」章（全章）
records.item_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě" — "Zǐ Huá sent to Qí" chapter (full chapter)
records.source_image: 图片4（古籍排印截图，标题「六之三」）
records.source_image_en: Image 4 (typeset page from a classical text, titled "六之三" / "six, three")
records.location: 《论语·雍也》篇（图中标题作“六之三”；通行本多标为第4章，分章编号因版本而异）
records.location_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě" chapter (titled "六之三" in the image; common editions label it chapter 4, with numbering varying by edition)
records.original_text: 子華使於齊，冉子為其母請粟。子曰：「與之釜。」請益，曰：「與之庾。」冉子與之粟五秉。子曰：「赤之適齊也，乘肥馬，衣輕裘；吾聞之也：君子周急不繼富。」原思為之宰，與之粟九百，辭。子曰：「毋！以與爾鄰里鄉黨乎！」
records.simplified: 子华使于齐，冉子为其母请粟。子曰：「与之釜。」请益，曰：「与之庾。」冉子与之粟五秉。子曰：「赤之适齐也，乘肥马，衣轻裘；吾闻之也：君子周急不继富。」原思为之宰，与之粟九百，辞。子曰：「毋！以与尔邻里乡党乎！」
records.pinyin: Zǐ Huá shǐ yú Qí, Rǎn Zǐ wèi qí mǔ qǐng sù. Zǐ yuē: "Yǔ zhī fǔ." Qǐng yì, yuē: "Yǔ zhī yǔ." Rǎn Zǐ yǔ zhī sù wǔ bǐng. Zǐ yuē: "Chì zhī shì Qí yě, chéng féi mǎ, yì qīng qiú; wú wén zhī yě: jūn zǐ zhōu jí bù jì fù." Yuán Sī wèi zhī zǎi, yǔ zhī sù jiǔ bǎi, cí. Zǐ yuē: "Wú! Yǐ yǔ ěr lín lǐ xiāng dǎng hū!"
records.english: Zi Hua was sent on a mission to Qi. Ran Zi asked for grain on behalf of his (Zi Hua's) mother. The Master said, "Give her a fu (6.4 dou)." He asked for more. [The Master] said, "Give her a yu (16 dou)." Ran Zi gave her five bing of grain (800 dou). The Master said, "When Chi set out for Qi, he rode a well-fed horse and wore a light fur robe. I have heard it said: a gentleman relieves those in urgent need; he does not add to the wealth of the rich." Yuan Si served as his (the Master's) household steward, and was given nine hundred measures of grain; he declined. The Master said, "Do not decline! Give it to your neighbours and fellow villagers!"
records.meaning: 全章两段，各记一事，主题同是“给予之道”。前段：公西赤（子华）出使齐国，冉有替子华之母请求补助粮米，孔子只许“釜”（六斗四升），冉有请增，孔子又许“庾”（十六斗），而冉有实际给了五秉（八百斗），远超师命；孔子于是点出子华出使时“乘肥马，衣轻裘”、家境殷实，何须多给，遂有“君子周急不继富”之论——君子只周济有急难的人，不给富人锦上添花。后段：原宪（原思）做孔子的家宰，孔子给他九百斗粟作俸禄，他推辞不受，孔子说“不要推辞！用不完就分给你的邻里乡党吧”。两段合观，可见孔子论施与的两条准则：急者当周、富者不继；该受之禄不必矫情推辞，受而有余则当散以济人。
records.meaning_en: The chapter has two parts, each recording an incident, both on the theme of "the way of giving." Part 1: Gōngxī Chì (Zǐ Huá) is sent on a mission to Qí; Rǎn Qiú asks the Master for grain for Zǐ Huá's mother. The Master allows only a "fǔ" (6.4 dǒu); when Rǎn asks for more, the Master allows a "yǔ" (16 dǒu); but Rǎn actually gives five "bǐng" (800 dǒu), far exceeding the Master's instruction. The Master then points out that when Chì went to Qí he "rode a fat horse and wore a light fur robe" — his family was well-off and needed no extra — and delivers the line "a gentleman relieves those in urgent need; he does not add to the wealth of the rich." Part 2: Yuán Xiàn (Yuán Sī), serving as the Master's household steward, is given nine hundred dǒu of grain as salary and declines; the Master says "Do not decline! Give it to your neighbours and fellow villagers." Together the two parts show Confucius's two rules for giving: relieve the needy and do not enrich the rich; accept the salary one should accept, and when one has surplus, share it to help others.
records.key_glosses: 釜＝古量名，六斗四升；庾＝古量名，十六斗（一说二斗四升）；秉＝古量名，十六斛＝160斗；周急不继富＝周济急难而不增益富人；邻里乡党＝古代基层编制，泛指乡亲邻里
records.key_glosses_en: fǔ = ancient measure, 6.4 dǒu; yǔ = ancient measure, 16 dǒu (some say 2.4 dǒu); bǐng = ancient measure, 16 hú = 160 dǒu; zhōu jí bù jì fù = relieve the urgent, do not enrich the rich; lín lǐ xiāng dǎng = ancient local-administrative units, generally "neighbours and fellow villagers"
records.confidence: 高（《论语》传世文本，字句明晰）
records.confidence_en: High (standard transmitted text of the Analects, clearly written)
records.notes: 本行是全章整体条目；TXT-01 至 TXT-10 为其逐句拆分，便于检索与教学。
records.notes_en: This row is the full-chapter entry; TXT-01 through TXT-10 are its sentence-by-sentence splits for easy lookup and teaching.

records.item_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," by sentence: 子華使於齊
records.source_image: 图片4（古籍排印截图，标题「六之三」）
records.location_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," 'Zǐ Huá sent to Qí' chapter
records.english: "Zi Hua was sent on a mission to Qi."
records.meaning: 子华，姓公西名赤，字子华（《论语》中又称“赤”），孔子弟子，少孔子四十二岁，以长于外交、宗庙之事著称。使於齐，即出使齐国。此句是全章的起因。
records.meaning_en: "Zǐ Huá" — surname Gōngxī, personal name Chì, courtesy name Zǐ Huá (also called "Chì" in the Analects) — was a disciple of Confucius, 42 years his junior, known for his skill in diplomacy and ancestral-temple rites. "Shǐ yú Qí" means he was sent on a mission to the state of Qí. This sentence is the trigger of the whole chapter.
records.key_glosses: 子华＝公西赤的字；使＝出使；於＝到、往；齐＝齐国
records.key_glosses_en: Zǐ Huá = courtesy name of Gōngxī Chì; shǐ = to send on a mission; yú = to, toward; Qí = the state of Qí
records.notes_en: Belongs to the full chapter in TXT-00.

records.item: 《论语·雍也》逐句：冉子為其母請粟
records.item_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," by sentence: 冉子為其母請粟
records.source_image: 图片4（古籍排印截图，标题「六之三」）
records.location_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," 'Zǐ Huá sent to Qí' chapter
records.pinyin: Rǎn Zǐ wèi qí mǔ qǐng sù
records.english: "Ran Zi asked [the Master] for grain on behalf of his (Zi Hua's) mother."
records.meaning: 冉子即冉求（字子有，通称冉有），孔子弟子，长于政事、善于理财。“其母”指子华之母：子华远行出使，冉有替他向孔子请求给他母亲一些粮米。
records.meaning_en: "Rǎn Zǐ" is Rǎn Qiú (courtesy name Zǐ Yǒu, commonly Rǎn Yǒu), a disciple renowned for statesmanship and financial management. "Qí mǔ" refers to Zǐ Huá's mother: while Zǐ Huá was away on the mission, Rǎn Qiú asked the Master for some grain for his mother.
records.key_glosses: 冉子＝冉求（冉有）；为＝替、给；其母＝他的母亲（指子华之母）；请＝请求；粟＝谷子、小米，泛指粮食
records.key_glosses_en: Rǎn Zǐ = Rǎn Qiú (Rǎn Yǒu); wèi = for, on behalf of; qí mǔ = his mother (Zǐ Huá's); qǐng = to request; sù = millet / grain
records.notes_en: Belongs to the full chapter in TXT-00.

records.item_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," by sentence: 子曰："與之釜。"
records.source_image: 图片4（古籍排印截图，标题「六之三」）
records.location_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," 'Zǐ Huá sent to Qí' chapter
records.english: "The Master said, 'Give her a fu (a measure of 6.4 dou).'"
records.meaning: 孔子只许给“釜”这么一釜粮。釜为古代量名，容六斗四升，数量很小——已暗含“不必多给”之意。
records.meaning_en: The Master allowed only a "fǔ" of grain. A fǔ was an ancient measure holding 6.4 dǒu — a very small amount — already implying "no need to give much."
records.key_glosses: 子＝孔子；曰＝说；与之＝给她；釜＝古量器/容量单位，一釜六斗四升
records.key_glosses_en: Zǐ = Confucius; yuē = said; yǔ zhī = give her; fǔ = ancient measure/unit, 6.4 dǒu
records.notes_en: Belongs to the full chapter in TXT-00.

records.item_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," by sentence: 請益
records.source_image: 图片4（古籍排印截图，标题「六之三」）
records.location_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," 'Zǐ Huá sent to Qí' chapter
records.meaning: 冉有觉得太少，请求增加。师徒二人对“该给多少”的分歧由此显现。
records.meaning_en: Rǎn felt it was too little and asked for an increase. The divergence between master and disciple over "how much to give" now appears.
records.key_glosses_en: qǐng = to request; yì = to increase
records.notes_en: Belongs to the full chapter in TXT-00.

records.item_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," by sentence: 曰："與之庾。"
records.source_image: 图片4（古籍排印截图，标题「六之三」）
records.location_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," 'Zǐ Huá sent to Qí' chapter
records.english: "'Give her a yu (a measure of 16 dou),' the Master said."
records.meaning: 孔子略增其数，但仍有限度。庾亦量名，朱熹《集注》作十六斗（郑玄一说为二斗四升）。此句中“与”读 yǔ，“庾”亦读 yǔ，二字同音。
records.meaning_en: The Master increased the amount slightly but kept it limited. A yǔ is another measure; Zhū Xī's commentary gives 16 dǒu (while Zhèng Xuán gives 2.4 dǒu). Note that "与" (yǔ, give) and "庾" (yǔ, the measure) are homophones.
records.key_glosses: 庾＝古量名，约十六斗（一说二斗四升）
records.key_glosses_en: yǔ = ancient measure, about 16 dǒu (some say 2.4 dǒu)
records.notes_en: Belongs to the full chapter in TXT-00.

records.item: 《论语·雍也》逐句：冉子與之粟五秉
records.item_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," by sentence: 冉子與之粟五秉
records.source_image: 图片4（古籍排印截图，标题「六之三」）
records.location_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," 'Zǐ Huá sent to Qí' chapter
records.pinyin: Rǎn Zǐ yǔ zhī sù wǔ bǐng
records.english: "Ran Zi gave her five bing of grain (about 800 dou)."
records.meaning: 冉有实际给了五秉。秉为古量名，一秉十六斛（一斛十斗），五秉即八百斗，约为孔子所许“庾”的五十倍，远远超出师命，为下句孔子的评论埋下伏笔。
records.meaning_en: Rǎn actually gave five bǐng. A bǐng was an ancient measure, one bǐng = 16 hú (one hú = 10 dǒu), so five bǐng = 800 dǒu — about fifty times the "yǔ" the Master allowed, far beyond the instruction, setting up the Master's comment in the next sentence.
records.key_glosses: 秉＝古量名，一秉十六斛（160斗）；五秉＝800斗
records.key_glosses_en: bǐng = ancient measure, one bǐng = 16 hú (160 dǒu); wǔ bǐng = 800 dǒu
records.notes_en: Belongs to the full chapter in TXT-00.

records.item: 《论语·雍也》逐句：子曰：“赤之適齊也，乘肥馬，衣輕裘；
records.item_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," by sentence: 子曰："赤之適齊也，乘肥馬，衣輕裘；
records.source_image: 图片4（古籍排印截图，标题「六之三」）
records.location_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," 'Zǐ Huá sent to Qí' chapter
records.original_text: 子曰：「赤之適齊也，乘肥馬，衣輕裘；
records.simplified: 子曰：「赤之适齐也，乘肥马，衣轻裘；
records.pinyin: Zǐ yuē: "Chì zhī shì Qí yě, chéng féi mǎ, yì qīng qiú;
records.english: "The Master said, 'When Chi set out for Qi, he rode a well-fed horse and wore a light fur robe.'"
records.meaning: 孔子点明子华的家境：出使齐国时驾着肥壮的马、穿着轻暖的皮袍，可见其家殷实、并不匮乏，无需多给。衣，此处名词动用，读 yì，是“穿”的意思；裘，皮衣。
records.meaning_en: The Master points out Zǐ Huá's family circumstances: when sent to Qí he drove a well-fed horse and wore a light, warm fur robe — clearly well-off and not in want, so no extra was needed. Here "衣" (yī) is used as a verb, read yì, meaning "to wear"; "裘" is a fur robe.
records.key_glosses: 赤＝公西赤（即子华）；之＝助词，用于主谓之间；适＝往、到；乘＝驾、乘坐（读 chéng）；肥马＝肥壮的马；衣＝穿（名词动用，读 yì）；轻裘＝轻暖的皮衣
records.key_glosses_en: Chì = Gōngxī Chì (i.e. Zǐ Huá); zhī = particle between subject and predicate; shì = to go to; chéng = to ride/drive (read chéng); féi mǎ = a fat/well-fed horse; yī = to wear (verb, read yì); qīng qiú = a light, warm fur robe
records.notes_en: Belongs to the full chapter in TXT-00.

records.item: 《论语·雍也》逐句：吾聞之也：君子周急不繼富。”
records.item_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," by sentence: 吾聞之也：君子周急不繼富。"
records.source_image: 图片4（古籍排印截图，标题「六之三」）
records.location_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," 'Zǐ Huá sent to Qí' chapter
records.original_text: 吾聞之也：君子周急不繼富。」
records.simplified: 吾闻之也：君子周急不继富」
records.pinyin: wú wén zhī yě: jūn zǐ zhōu jí bù jì fù."
records.english: "'I have heard it said: a gentleman relieves those in urgent need; he does not add to the wealth of the rich.'"
records.meaning: 全章点睛之语。周＝周济、救济；急＝急难、急需；继＝接续、增益；富＝富有者。意为：君子应在别人有急难时给予帮助，而不该给本就富足的人再添财富。这是孔子对冉有多给粮米的委婉批评，也确立了儒家“济困而不助富”的施与原则（后世成语“周急济贫”即由此而来）。
records.meaning_en: The punchline of the chapter. "Zhōu" = to relieve/aid; "jí" = urgent need; "jì" = to add to / continue; "fù" = the wealthy. It means: a gentleman helps those in urgent need, and does not pile more wealth onto those who already have it. This is Confucius's gentle rebuke of Rǎn for over-giving, and establishes the Confucian principle of "helping the distressed, not aiding the rich" (whence the later idiom "zhōu jí jì pín," relieve the urgent and aid the poor).
records.key_glosses: 吾闻之也＝我听说过这样的话；君子＝有德之人；周＝周济、救济；急＝急难、急需；继＝增益、接续；富＝富有
records.key_glosses_en: wú wén zhī yě = I have heard such words; jūn zǐ = the gentleman / person of virtue; zhōu = to relieve/aid; jí = urgent need; jì = to add to; fù = wealthy
records.notes_en: Belongs to the full chapter in TXT-00.

records.item: 《论语·雍也》逐句：原思為之宰，與之粟九百，辭。
records.item_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," by sentence: 原思為之宰，與之粟九百，辭。
records.source_image: 图片4（古籍排印截图，标题「六之三」）
records.location_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," 'Zǐ Huá sent to Qí' chapter
records.original_text: 原思為之宰，與之粟九百，辭。
records.simplified: 原思为之宰，与之粟九百，辞。
records.pinyin: Yuán Sī wèi zhī zǎi, yǔ zhī sù jiǔ bǎi, cí.
records.english: "Yuan Si served as his (the Master's) household steward; [the Master] gave him nine hundred measures of grain, and he declined."
records.meaning: 原思，姓原名宪，字子思，孔子弟子，以安贫乐道著称。他做孔子的家宰后，孔子给他九百（斗）粟作俸禄，他因嫌多而推辞。此段与上段互为对照：一个（冉有）是替他人多要，一个（原思）是辞去自己的俸禄。
records.meaning_en: Yuán Sī — surname Yuán, personal name Xiàn, courtesy name Zǐ Sī — was a disciple known for being content in poverty and devoted to the Way. After becoming Confucius's household steward, the Master gave him nine hundred (dǒu) of grain as salary, and he declined because he felt it was too much. This part contrasts with the previous: there, Rǎn gave too much to another; here, Yuán declines his own salary.
records.key_glosses: 原思＝原宪，字子思，孔子弟子；为之宰＝做他的家宰（家臣总管）；与＝给予；粟九百＝九百（斗）粟，指俸禄；辞＝推辞、不接受
records.key_glosses_en: Yuán Sī = Yuán Xiàn, courtesy Zǐ Sī, a disciple; wèi zhī zǎi = to serve as his household steward; yǔ = to give; sù jiǔ bǎi = nine hundred (dǒu) of grain, i.e. salary; cí = to decline
records.notes_en: Belongs to the full chapter in TXT-00.

records.item: 《论语·雍也》逐句：子曰：“毋！以與爾鄰里鄉黨乎！”
records.item_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," by sentence: 子曰："毋！以與爾鄰里鄉黨乎！"
records.source_image: 图片4（古籍排印截图，标题「六之三」）
records.location_en: "The Analects · Yōng yě," 'Zǐ Huá sent to Qí' chapter
records.original_text: 子曰：「毋！以與爾鄰里鄉黨乎！」
records.simplified: 子曰：「毋！以与尔邻里乡党乎！」
records.pinyin: Zǐ yuē: "Wú! Yǐ yǔ ěr lín lǐ xiāng dǎng hū!"
records.english: "The Master said, 'Do not decline it! Give it to your neighbours and fellow villagers!'"
records.meaning: 孔子不许他推辞，而是指点他把多余的粮食分给乡邻。“邻里乡党”为古代基层编制：五家为邻，五邻为里（二十五家），五百家为党，一万二千五百家为乡，后泛指邻里乡亲。此句与“周急不继富”互相发明：合礼之禄当受，受而有余则当散以济人——该拿的拿，该给的给。
records.meaning_en: The Master forbids him to decline, and instead tells him to distribute the surplus grain to his neighbours. "Lín lǐ xiāng dǎng" were ancient grassroots units: five families made a lín, five lín made a lǐ (25 families), 500 families a dǎng, and 12,500 a xiāng; later it simply means neighbours and fellow villagers. This line complements "relieve the urgent, not the rich": a salary that is proper should be accepted, and what one has in surplus should be shared to help others — take what one should take, give what one should give.
records.key_glosses: 毋＝不要（推辞）；以＝把（它）；与＝给予；尔＝你的；邻里乡党＝古代地方组织，泛指乡亲邻里（五家为邻、五邻为里、五百家为党、万二千五百家为乡）
records.key_glosses_en: wú = do not (decline); yǐ = take/bring (it); yǔ = to give; ěr = your; lín lǐ xiāng dǎng = ancient local units, generally "neighbours and fellow villagers" (5 families = lín; 5 lín = lǐ; 500 = dǎng; 12,500 = xiāng)
records.notes_en: Belongs to the full chapter in TXT-00.
